stableFactsAndClaims: Recovery copies are local to the same device and are not independent backups against device loss or storage failure.
The panel shows title, last local save time, and approximate size; contents appear only through Preview.
Preview opens saved text alongside the current document without replacing either; closing it commits no change.
Restore requires title confirmation and creates a new document; the current document remains open and merging is manual.
Blocked browser storage produces a message and no copies; no substitute is silently uploaded.
Shared-device users should clear copies because others using the browser profile may preview them.
The June 2 session demonstrates previewing, restoring, and removing copies; absent members receive a written guide afterward.
